title: Pokemon Glimmora ex 213/197 Obsidian Flames Secret Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Glimmora ex, #213/197, Obsidian Flames (SV3).
Stage 1 (Evolves from Glimmet), HP 270. Ability: Dust Field. Attack: Poisonous Gem (140 dmg, opponent's Active becomes Poisoned). Pokémon ex rule — opponent takes 2 Prize cards on KO. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics. Card number exceeds the set's base count of 197, indicating a secret rare print.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
